changelog: Phase L103.1 — schema + reference data for 6-tier per-location pricing (Меню/Заказ+/Доставка+/Контроль+/Смена+/Кухня+). New control-plane tables: tariffs (8 seed rows), tenant_locations (FK-mirror), subscriptions (one per tenant+location). Extends subscription_invoices/addon_purchases/subscription_events with nullable location_id. ZERO behaviour change — application code still reads tenants.plan_id until Phase L103.6 swap. Migration sql/l103-six-tier-migration.sql is idempotent and safe to deploy any time.
